name: template-context
body:
The execution context of a template is not only its field values and rendered body: every slide layout and every section template is also given a reserved deck/slide data context — a `deck` entry with the deck-wide data (`title`, `author`, `date` and the author's `properties`) and a `slide` entry with the current slide's derived metadata (`number` and `total`). This is data, never a helper: no function is added and the v1 helper set stays exactly `media` (template-language). `deck` and `slide` are reserved top-level names, so a template may not declare a field or a section named `deck` or `slide` (template-build-checks). The same context is present in a slide's layout and in every section instance's execution, at every composition depth.
AC: `{{.deck.title}}`, `{{.deck.author}}`, `{{.deck.date}}`, `{{index .deck.properties "audience"}}` and `{{.slide.number}}`/`{{.slide.total}}` render from a slide layout and from a section template; loading a template that declares a field or section named `deck` or `slide` is a templates error.
